components.code: # About Formester **From a Freelancer’s Frustration to a Global Solution** Formester started with a simple need, **a better way to collect leads.** In 2018, our founder, **Ankit Singhaniya**, left his full-time job to freelance. Like many freelancers, he struggled to collect client info and manage leads efficiently. So, he built a basic online form tool for himself. That tool? It later became **Formester**. ### Why We Exist We believe anyone, **even with zero coding skills**, should be able to build powerful online forms, surveys, and quizzes. Whether you’re a **marketer, business owner, teacher, or freelancer**, Formester helps you launch faster and grow smarter. ### Our Journey In 2021, Ankit teamed up with fellow software engineer **Tarun Bhukya** to reimagine Formester as a full no-code form builder. Since then, we've been building features that actually solve real problems: * **AI Form Generator** – Build full forms in seconds * **Multilingual Forms** – Reach users in any language * **Calculation Fields & Logic** – Personalize experiences * **Collaboration, Prefill, PDF to Form, Partial Submission** – And more! Formester is now trusted by **10000+ users** and growing, all without a single dollar of outside funding. ### What Drives Us We’re bootstrapped, so **our only boss is you.** Every feature, every update, every fix comes from user feedback. We're not chasing investor slides, we’re focused on solving your everyday problems. ### The Future We’re scaling up, hiring passionate people, and expanding features. But our core promise stays the same, **make online form building fast, easy, and fun.** ### Join our journey Whether you're launching a side hustle, gathering feedback, or running a global team, Formester is built for you.
